# MediaZip

> MediaZip is a free, open-source Discord app that saves every image and video of a Discord message at once, as separate files or one ZIP, straight to your device. It works on desktop and mobile, in every server and DM.

## What it does

- Adds a **Download media** command to a message's **Apps** menu in Discord. MediaZip replies privately (only you see the reply) with thumbnails and two buttons: **Download all** saves every file separately, **Download ZIP** saves them as one ZIP.
- Each button opens the download page at {{BASE_URL}}. The page fetches the files from Discord and saves them one by one, builds the ZIP in your browser, or offers your device's share sheet where the browser supports it.
- Installed to your Discord account, it works in every server and DM, including ones where the bot isn't a member.

## How to use it

- **Download media:** right-click (or long-press on mobile) a message, then choose **Apps** → **Download media**.
- **Add to ZIP:** choose **Apps** → **Add to ZIP** on several messages (up to 10 by default) to collect them into one ZIP with a folder per message. Your ZIP is kept as one message in your DM with the bot; its **Download your ZIP** button downloads the whole collection.
- **/zip:** `/zip show`, `/zip link` and `/zip clear` show, link or empty your ZIP.
- **DM forwarding:** forward messages, or upload files, to the bot's DM. The bot sends one reply with a link for all of them.

## What it saves

- Images and videos (including GIFs) from a message's attachments and embeds.
- Not documents, PDFs, archives or other files: Discord's CDN allows browsers to fetch images and videos from other sites (CORS), but not other file types, so the download page can't fetch them.

## Privacy in short

- The files go directly between your browser and Discord's CDN. MediaZip's server never handles the file bytes, and the ZIP is built on your device.
- Download links expire after 60 minutes (sooner if Discord's file links expire first) and can be revoked with the **Revoke** button. Links and ZIPs are kept in memory only, never on disk.
- The link's secret stays in the URL fragment, which browsers never send to the server; the server stores only its SHA-256 hash.
- No analytics, no cookies, no third-party scripts. Only aggregate daily usage counters are saved, without user IDs, IP addresses, links or file names.
- The site is served through Cloudflare's proxy, which handles the HTTPS connection but not the files.

## Install

- [Add MediaZip to your Discord account]({{BASE_URL}}/install): user install, works in every server and DM.
- [Add MediaZip to a server]({{BASE_URL}}/install?type=guild): makes it available to everyone there (needs Manage Server). Optional.
